name: Dynamics 365
summary: Model-driven applications of Dynamics 365 and Power Apps: a form's notification is a bar at the top of the form that stays until it is cleared, an error also shows beside its field, and Ctrl+S saves.

evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Power Apps client API reference, setFormNotification
evidence.says: A form notification stays visible until the code removes it, and its level is error, warning or information.

evidence.source: Microsoft Learn, Power Apps, Keyboard shortcuts in model-driven apps
Fluent 2 Design System, Message bar, usage
evidence.says: When a form is submitted with errors, the focus moves to the message bar at the top of the form, and inline error messages beside the fields reinforce it.
